summary: Phase 5 testing of iWhistle B2B Partnership Portal - tested all 14 specified features. Backend: 9/9 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 13/14 features pass. One persistent minor UX bug: logout redirects to /login instead of / (same as iteration_4). All new Phase 5 features (Partner Dashboard, Signature Pad, Partner Spotlight, Application Status Tracking) are working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout (partner-logout-btn and admin-logout-btn) redirects to /login instead of / (home). navigate('/') is called before logout() but ProtectedRoute's Navigate to='/login' replace overrides it. Same race condition as iteration_4.

issues: DocumentViewer component receives `document={document}` (browser's window.document passed as React prop named 'document') - code smell that shadows the global. Works correctly but is bad practice and confusing.

action_items: FIX (Minor): Logout redirects to /login instead of /. Fix: In PartnerDashboard.handleLogout and AdminDashboard.handleLogout, use window.location.href = '/' instead of navigate('/') to bypass ProtectedRoute interception, OR add a post-logout redirect in ProtectedRoute that checks if navigating from logout.

CODE QUALITY: DocumentViewer in PartnerDashboard DocumentsTab passes document={document} (window.document as prop). Rename prop to avoid shadowing global. Also the component doesn't use the document prop for anything meaningful in rendering - only for document.body.style manipulation which could be done directly.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentViewer.js line 6: prop named 'document' shadows window.document. In PartnerDashboard.js line 357, `document={document}` passes window.document as prop. Should be removed or renamed.
DocumentViewer.js: AnimatePresence exit animation means document-viewer-panel element persists briefly after close button click. Not a bug but may cause confusion in tests.

PartnerDashboard/AdminDashboard: logout navigation race condition - ProtectedRoute redirects to /login before navigate('/') takes effect. Fix: use window.location.href or restructure ProtectedRoute to not redirect on logout action.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: In PartnerDashboard.handleLogout: navigate('/') then logout() is called sequentially. When logout() fires, AuthContext sets isAuthenticated=false which triggers React re-render. ProtectedRoute at /portal sees isAuthenticated=false and renders <Navigate to='/login' replace />. This replace redirect overrides the pending navigate('/') because React Router's replace causes history replacement.
rca_of_issue.fix: Change to: window.location.href = '/'; setTimeout(() => logout(), 100); OR change ProtectedRoute to not redirect if user explicitly initiated logout (add a logout flag to context).
